title: Glowing orb UFOs at Pyramid Kuromanta shown in old paintings

tellings.quote: There is a phenomenon that occurs at Pyramid Coramanta that's been shown in ancient paintings of these glowing balls

plain: Glowing balls of light are said to appear at Pyramid Kuromanta, a mountain in Akita, Japan that some regard as a pyramid, and old Japanese paintings are said to show the same lights. A guest named Geoffrey Drumm tells Michels this as a known phenomenon, pointing to an old painting of glowing balls without naming it. If true, it would mean the lights have been seen there for centuries.
